parent_domains.justification: "Older adult care" is a subset of health care, as it pertains specifically to the care needs of older adults within the broader healthcare system.
Older adult care is a specific type of patient care focusing on the elderly, thus making it a subset of the general domain of patient care.
Research in older adult care can be considered a part of health services research as it deals with understanding and improving care systems for older adults.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Health care is the broadest and most encompassing category under which older adult care directly falls, as all aspects of care specific to older adults are part of the healthcare system.

closest_child_domain.justification: There are no child domains listed under "older adult care" in the Given List, as none directly pertain specifically to sub-sections of older adult care.

sibling_domains.justification: Both older adult care and family-centered care are specialized areas within the broader healthcare field focused on specific groups or methods of care.
Emergency care, like older adult care, is another specialized area under the broad healthcare umbrella.
This focuses on personalized care approaches, similar to older adult care, which tailors healthcare to specific population needs (like older adults).

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Patient-centered care most closely aligns with older adult care, as both prioritize tailoring medical approaches to meet the specific needs of the patient population.

unrelated_domains.justification: Pediatrics is unrelated to older adult care as it focuses on children's healthcare, which is a different demographic group.
This domain is centered around children's emergency medical care and does not relate to older adults.
Focused on surgical care for children, it does not intersect with older adult care.
